description: This file defines the LocalizationService class responsible for handling localization functions in the OrangeHRM system. It manages language data, translation validation, import/export of language packages in XLIFF format, and error handling related to localization strings.

classes.name: LocalizationService
classes.description: Service class for managing localization, language data, translation validation, import/export operations, and error handling within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getLocalizationDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the LocalizationDao instance for database operations related to localization.

methods.name: getI18NService
methods.description: Retrieves the I18NService instance from the dependency container.

methods.name: getLocalizationDateFormats
methods.description: Returns an array of supported date formats with labels including current date instances.

methods.name: getSupportedDateFormats
methods.description: Provides a list of date format patterns with their descriptive labels.

methods.name: getCurrentDateFormat
methods.description: Returns the default date format configuration.

methods.name: getSupportedLanguages
methods.description: Fetches all enabled and recently added languages, normalized into arrays.

methods.name: searchLanguages
methods.description: Performs a search for languages based on parameters.

methods.name: getLanguagesArray
methods.description: Normalizes search result language objects into an array of language models.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTranslatedStringsFromRows
methods.description: Creates translation objects from rows and saves them, then clears cache.

methods.name: saveImportErrorLangStringsFromRows
methods.description: Creates import error entries from rows for a specific language and employee.

methods.name: createTranslatedItemsFromRows
methods.description: Generates I18NTranslation objects from provided rows, linked by language and string IDs.

methods.name: createImportErrorItemsFromRows
methods.description: Creates I18NImportError objects from rows, detailing import issues.

methods.name: generateLangStringLanguageKey
methods.description: Constructs a unique key for language string identification.

methods.name: exportLanguagePackage
methods.description: Exports language data into an XLIFF formatted string for external use.

methods.name: getXliffXmlSources
methods.description: Builds an XML DOMDocument representing the language's translation groups and strings.

methods.name: getTargetLanguageFromFile
methods.description: Extracts the target language code from an XLIFF DOMDocument.

methods.name: validateTargetString
methods.description: Checks translation string syntax validity against source, returns errors if mismatched or invalid.

methods.name: getI18NErrorByName
methods.description: Retrieves an I18NError object based on its name.

methods.name: processXliffFile
methods.description: Validates and processes an uploaded XLIFF file, returning valid and invalid language strings.

methods.name: validateXliffFile
methods.description: Checks validity of the XLIFF file, schema, structure, and target language correctness.

methods.name: validateLangStrings
methods.description: Validates each language string within an XLIFF, categorizing into valid, invalid, or skipped.

methods.name: languageHasImportErrors
methods.description: Checks if a language has import errors for a specific employee.

methods.name: clearImportErrorsForLangStrings
methods.description: Clears import error records for specified language strings.
